title: Harbor triangle rezoning including Maui Ocean Center
summary: On October 19, a council committee voted 8–0, with one member excused, to recommend adopting Resolution 26-137, which now goes to the full council. It would send a zoning change for six parcels near the harbor, including Maui Ocean Center and the harbor shops, to the Maui Planning Commission. The owners' consultant said the change would make the whole property B2 business zoning, fix labels that don't exist in county code, and involve no new development.
